target_review.notes: Compared the complete problem (including its original proof) with target-selection, proof-context, spec and P. Prime p, arbitrary characteristic-p field K, integer 0≤lambda<p, dimension lambda+1, the exact Chevalley normalization and highest-weight data, and arbitrary U_Z-stable admissible M are preserved. P includes both nonzeroness and every invariant K-subspace being zero or whole, using the original M⊗K and formal Chevalley algebra, including lambda=0 and p=2. No constant dependency is changed. The authorized B101/B102/B104/B103/B105/B106 route corresponds to N001/N002/N003/N004/N005/P. All six replacement entries were compared: localization, rational coordinate rank and valuation/principal-ideal claims are eliminated, while integral operator identities, tensor swap and abstract matrix-unit dimension reasoning are internal derivations. The common-basis reindexing uses B007/M008–M009 rather than imposing a special lattice. This is target and route fidelity, not approval of unreviewed R bodies.

D001.notes: Int.toNat is a total natural-valued construction from the integer parameter. Equality lambda=(ell:Z) is exported by N001, rather than assumed in this definition; H003 retains nonnegativity.

D002.notes: n=ell+1 defines a positive finite index length. Fin(n) gives exactly 0≤i≤ell; integer subtraction in weight formulas is explicitly distinguished from natural index subtraction.

D003.notes: The divided power is defined over C for every natural r, including r=0. Factorials have nonzero complex images; this introduces neither a characteristic-p division nor a stability assumption.

D004.notes: The analogous lowering divided powers are defined for every natural r over C, with the usual zeroth power. Their lattice preservation is separately guarded by H007.

D005.notes: U_Z is the original generated integer subalgebra of the enveloping algebra; its represented generators are distinguished from the abstract algebra. This preserves precisely the original admissibility condition.

D006.notes: This is the original tensor product M⊗_Z K and its second-factor K-action. It exists for the ambient Z-module M without freeness or nonzeroness; neither property is assumed here.

D007.notes: The auxiliary tensor product reverses the factors and uses the first-factor K-action. It is not silently identified with V_K: S and its inverse are defined separately and their properties are exported by N003.

D008.notes: Stable is the universally quantified preservation predicate for a linear subspace and an endomorphism over the same arbitrary field. All dummy objects are locally bound.

D009.notes: The vectors e_i are explicitly defined from v,y and complex factorial inverses on Fin(n). This definition grants no basis property, integrality, or membership in M; N001 supplies the basis theorem.

D010.notes: The restriction X_r|M exists because H007 says every represented divided-power generator preserves M. Its inherited Z-linearity gives End_Z(M); the H007 guard is retained.

D011.notes: The lowering restriction is likewise well-defined and Z-linear under the explicit H007 admissibility guard, without assuming individual e_i belong to M.

D012.notes: X_M(1) is exactly the restriction of x because 1!=1. The inherited H007 guard is explicit.

D013.notes: Y_M(1) is exactly the restriction of y because 1!=1. The inherited H007 guard is explicit.

D014.notes: The commutator of two Z-endomorphisms is a well-defined Z-endomorphism. Equality to the restriction of h is reserved for N002 using H005; no preservation of h is smuggled into the definition.

D015.notes: The binomial coefficient is natural-valued on j≤ell supplied by Fin(ell+1). Its nonzero reduction is not assumed; it is an N004 conclusion.

D016.notes: The composition of restricted divided powers defines an integral endomorphism under H007. No projection or matrix-unit property is granted here.

D017.notes: All factors are integral endomorphisms under H007. For i,j∈Fin(ell+1), ell−i and ell−j are nonnegative natural indices. The order of composition agrees with the authorized basis route.

D018.notes: The finite product of the c_j is a defined natural number. No invertibility, divisibility, or nonzero property is assumed.

D019.notes: The finite product omitting j is well-defined, with empty product 1, covering ell=0. The product identity with c_j is subsequently exported by N002.

D020.notes: The rule (a,m)↦a⊗f(m) is additive and Z-balanced since f is Z-linear, hence induces an additive tensor map; it commutes with K-scaling on the first factor. Ring-homomorphism laws are expressly left to N003/E001.

D021.notes: Tensor swapping is additive and Z-balanced: (zm)⊗a and m⊗(za) map to equal balanced tensors. Thus the additive map exists without any basis choice; K-linearity and invertibility are separate N003 conclusions.

D022.notes: The reversed balanced tensor formula similarly defines an additive map. Its name does not assume the inverse laws; those are in N003.

D023.notes: This is the canonical integer homomorphism into the field, which exists independently of its characteristic. Sum/product/one preservation belongs to that canonical construction; its kernel and nonzero factorial images are not assumed.

D024.notes: Field inverse is explicitly total, so this definition is meaningful even before proving red(c_j)≠0. Cancellation and the normalized matrix-unit relations are N004 obligations; H007 guards A_ij.

D025.notes: The rule (m,a)↦f(m)⊗a is additive and Z-balanced, and commutes with K-scaling on the second factor. It therefore defines exactly the original induced lattice operator for any integral endomorphism.

D026.notes: The formal rank-three Chevalley Z-module is distinguished from its possibly nonfaithful represented image, preserving the lambda=0 case. The displayed alternating bilinear bracket is consistent: Jacobi on the distinct basis triple is 0+2h−2h=0, and repeated-generator cases cancel.

D027.notes: Scalar extension of that formal integral Lie algebra defines the original Chevalley L_K, including characteristic 2. The assigned generators initially give a K-linear map; bracket preservation is deferred to proof. H007 and N002 are explicit guards and are direct inputs to the sole consumer R006.
